title: Prochlorperazine vs Imitrex for Acute Migraine in the Emergency Department
brief_summary: ED patients with acute migraine will be randomized to either prochlorperazine and Bendaryl OR imitrex. VAS for pain will be monitored, along with side effects. Primary outcome measure is improvement in pain scales between the groups.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Acute migraine headache

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant
* Hypertension
* Chest pain
* \< 18
* Allergy to any of the meds
